attack.note: Mech Mode Fusion Cannons are a short range cone with 40 percent bonus damage up close, and Self Destruct charge builds from auto time. Pilot Mode swaps to a ranged pistol and Big Shot. Mech autos matter for charge and Rush-down.

poke.note: No poke. Her damage is close range cannon fire and Self Destruct.

damage.note: Fusion Cannons are steady short range AoE chip. Self Destruct (400 to 1100) is her burst and can hit a clump. Defense Matrix cuts enemy hero damage by 60 percent in a field, which reduces what healers need to undo. Siege is very high at 6613 per minute.

good_into.why: Defense Matrix reduces damage by 60 percent in an area and she gets a second life as a Pilot, so chip damage into her is wasted.
Defense Matrix blocks projectile and spell damage on the team, and Boosters closes the gap on backliners.
Very high siege damage, 50 percent Self Destruct against structures, and Micro Missiles and Bunny Hop strip towers.
Boosters knocks away, Bunny Hop stomps stun on the fourth hit, and Self Destruct kills clustered squishies.

bad_into.why: Mech health is a second pool but burst plus Pilot Mode leaves her without Defense Matrix and mobility for a 45 second Call Mech cooldown.
Stuns, silences and roots interrupt Boosters and Self Destruct timing, and Bunny Hop only grants Unstoppable on that heroic.
Her mech has no big self heal outside Liquid Cooling and Full Metal, so a team without healing cannot refill it across a long siege.
Fusion Cannons are physical close range chip and do little against heavy armor.

wants_from_team: Damage dealers to turn her Defense Matrix and engage into kills
A healer to refill the mech between fights
Follow up on her Boosters knockback
gives_team: Defense Matrix damage reduction field for the whole team
Mobile engage and disengage with Boosters
Bunny Hop or Micro Missiles as flexible heroics
weaknesses: Mech and Pilot cooldown cycle leaves gaps
Blind and silence stop Defense Matrix tactics
Needs damage dealers to convert her setup
evidence: Boosters, Defense Matrix, Self Destruct, Call Mech, Big Shot abilities
Bunny Hop, Micro Missiles, Diverting Power, Aggression Matrix, Target Locked talents
Measured: win rate 0.492, siege 6613 per minute (highest of my set), damage taken 3982, 6.9 seconds of CC applied per game
owner_notes: A bruiser. Soaks lanes, controls points with her bombs, and disrupts fights with Bunny Hop.

lens_notes.frontline_style: Owner says she disrupts fights with Bunny Hop and controls points with bombs, so disruptor over a classic tank value.
lens_notes.durability_source: Mech health pool plus the Pilot second life; Defense Matrix cuts damage 60 percent in a field.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Boosters knockback is the reliable tool; Bunny Hop stun is a heroic.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Bunny Hop for the fight swing, Micro Missiles is the siege alternative.
lens_notes.utility_tool: Defense Matrix is a team damage reduction field that no utility value describes.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Self Destruct on a clump plus Boosters onto backliners.

lens_gaps: no value for team damage reduction field on utility_tool
no value for two health pools or second life on durability_source
